changes: Weekday changed from 'somavāsara' to 'somavāra', the standard form of the colophon's 'somavārasare'.

Notes: added the CE date of the exemplar (NS 686 ≈ 1566 CE). Also noted that Pauṣa śukla of NS 1018 falls in Dec 1897/Jan 1898, so the copy may date from late 1897. Kept 1898 as ce_approx by the NS+880 convention.
Otherwise the first reading is confirmed: no named persons, and the copy is dated NS 1018 Pauṣa śukla 4, Monday, as against the catalogue's NS 686.

date.as_written: svasti śrīnepālisamvat 1018 mitipauṣaśudi cautitithau || somavārasare sampūrṇam

notes: The catalogue gives NS 686 as the date of copying, but the colophon says NS 686 Bhādrapada śukla 9, Monday, is the date of the exemplar ('gurūpustakako miti', NS 686 ≈ 1566 CE). The present copy was completed on NS 1018 Pauṣa śukla 4 ('cauti'), Monday. NS 1018 began in about Oct/Nov 1897, so Pauṣa śukla falls in Dec 1897 or Jan 1898. ce_approx 1898 follows the NS+880 convention. The ye dharmā verse is badly corrupt. No scribe, patron or owner is named.
